sections.title: Advanced Topics in Implementation Science in Health
sections.description: Summary. This seminar course is designed to advance and deepen students’ understanding of emerging issues in implementation science as they relate to implementation models, strategies, outcomes and study design. Attendees should be able to directly apply their learnings to their ongoing or proposed implementation research. This half credit course is intended for those who have already been exposed to the foundational content of implementation science. This can be achieved via IMP 6000, HPR 6100, the Penn Implementation Science Institute, or other training opportunities such as, IRI, the NIH TIDIRH/TIDIRC or mentored K awards.
